businesses.business: billboards, broadband and insurance holding company

offering_description.value: Holding company that owns outdoor advertising billboards, fiber broadband internet service, and insurance businesses including surety and reinsurance. It sells advertising space to local and national advertisers, internet service to residential and business subscribers, and insurance to businesses.

primary_services.value: outdoor advertising; broadband internet service; surety insurance; reinsurance; insurance underwriting

customer_segment.value: B2B: local and national advertisers, businesses buying broadband, contractors buying surety bonds, insurers ceding reinsurance; B2C: residential broadband subscribers

end_markets.value: outdoor advertising; telecommunications; insurance and surety; construction

revenue_model.value: service fees: billboard advertising space rented to advertisers; subscription: monthly broadband internet service plans; interest or premiums: insurance and surety premiums plus investment income
revenue_model.category: service fees; subscription; interest or premiums

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and operates billboard structures and fiber broadband networks, selling to advertisers and subscribers; financial intermediary: underwrites surety and reinsurance risk, selling to contractors and insurers

geography_served.value: US national: Billboards and broadband in selected US states, insurance across the US

specialization.value: diversified: Separate businesses: outdoor billboards, fiber broadband, and insurance/surety

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales staff selling billboard ads and broadband to customers; agents / brokers: independent agents and brokers placing surety and insurance

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Insurance regulated by state insurance departments, billboards under local zoning and federal highway rules, broadband under FCC rules

notes: Business mix may have changed; company also holds large equity investments not described here.
